questions.question:
Select the set of letters that, when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series, will complete the letter series.

p_1_c t_h 1 r_t p h_r_t
questions.solution:
1) h r p c 1 t

Given sequence: p_1_c t_h 1 r_t p h_r_t

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

p**h**1**r**c t / **p**h 1 r**c**t / p h**1**r**t**t

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into three equal parts.

2) h r p c 1 c

Given sequence: p_1_c t_h 1 r_t p h_r_t

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

p**h**1**r**c t / **p**h 1 r**c**t / p h**1**r**c**t

A particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into three equal parts.

3) r h p c 1 c 

Given sequence: p_1_c t_h 1 r_t p h_r_t

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

p**r**1**h**c t / **p**h 1 r**c**t / p h**1**r**c**t

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into three equal parts.

4) h r 1 c 1 p

Given sequence: p_1_c t_h 1 r_t p h_r_t

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

p**h**1**r**c t / **1**h 1 r**c**t / p h**1**r**p**t

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into three equal parts. 

Hence, ‘**h r p c 1 c**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

29 : 116 : : 43 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

29 : 116 → 29 : 29 × 4

Similarly,

43 : ? → 43 : 43 × 4

=> ? = 172

Hence, ‘**172**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All plants are flowers.

Some plants are leaves.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some flowers are leaves.

II. Some flowers are plants.

options.text: Both the conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32077964fe8767cd047cdbae3bd004721ec957e45c7ff89a0c90321aabcc0e22.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flowers are leaves. → True (As, All plants are flowers and Some plants are leaves → Some flowers are leaves)

II. Some flowers are plants. → True (As, All plants are flowers → Some flowers are leaves)

Hence, **both the conclusions I and II follow**.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statement to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some engineers are doctors.

Some doctors are architects.

Some architects are designers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some designers are engineers.

II. Some architects are doctors.

III. Some doctors are engineers.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f11ec94630ffa8c6142b84434ea47cd3f376c215020b1b52f0dfffc1c1720851.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some designers are engineers. → False (It can be possible but it is not definite, because there is no direct relation between designers and engineers).

II. Some architects are doctors. → True (As, Some doctors are architects)

III. Some doctors are engineers. → True (As, Some engineers are doctors)

Hence, **only conclusions II and III follow**.

questions.question: In a code language, 'PREY' is written as 'EPRY' and TOOLS is written as LOOST. How will 'TESTS' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfac4a3fedc96c29402ed02a4d9adf88d8ff11a8bbc2297b2c889dfdf3c431eb.png] 

Logic Followed here is:

**Letters are arranged in order as they appear in the English alphabetical series.**

PREY → EPRY

TOOLS → LOOST 

Similarly,

TESTS → ESSTT

Hence, ‘**ESSTT**’ is the correct answer.
